jobs.title: Senior TypeScript Engineer (Node.js, AWS Serverless), FinTech
jobs.description:
**Senior TypeScript Engineer (Node.js, AWS Serverless), FinTech**  



**Location:** London, Manchester, Leeds, Edinburgh or Bristol (flexible hybrid)
  

  

**Rate:** £600 per day. Inside IR35  

  

**Duration:** 6 months

 **About Codurance**


We're a software craftsmanship consultancy. We build software for clients, and we care about doing it properly: clean code, solid testing, sensible architecture, and teams that keep learning. Our engineers work embedded with client teams, so you get variety, real ownership, and the backing of a wider community of craftspeople who'll challenge you and help you grow.

 **The role**


We're looking for a senior contract engineer to work on a financial platform where correctness actually matters. You'll design, build, and run TypeScript and Node.js services on AWS serverless infrastructure. You'll work in a small, cross\-functional team alongside product, operations, and customer\-facing colleagues, and you'll be the person people go to when they're stuck. This is a build\-and\-run environment: if you build it, you own it in production.

 **What you'll do day to day**

* Design, build, and operate services within your domain, from architecture through to delivery
* Take accountability for the SLAs of what you ship, and keep improving it
* Write and maintain useful documentation for your services
* Mentor and guide other engineers
* Explain how the system works to non\-technical colleagues, without making them feel daft for asking
* Judge when "good enough for now" is the right call, and when it isn't
* Work openly with product and operations, and challenge ideas constructively

 **Requirements**  

Core skills:

* Strong commercial experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Hands\-on AWS experience, including serverless (Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, ECS)
* Strong experience with event\-driven architecture
* Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB
* A track record of leading technical delivery in a build\-and\-run model
* Experience mentoring other engineers
* Experience with incident management
* Experience in a regulated industry, ideally financial services or FinTech

  

Also important:

* Solid experience designing, building, and running high\-quality workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance
* Comfort working with distributed systems and debugging through tracing and observability tooling
* Experience in a strongly, statically typed language
* The ability to turn business and customer problems into efficient, scalable solutions
* Curiosity about how investment and custody products work

  

Nice to have:

* Experience with multi\-region, multi\-currency or trading\-related systems
* Terraform, Serverless Framework and GitHub Actions
* Some exposure to C\#

 **How we work**


We care about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. You'll have autonomy, and with it, full accountability. We'd rather you tell us something is wrong than nod along.

 **Benefits** *Everyone should have the right to bring their whole self to work and be celebrated for who they are. Our people are hired purely on their commitment to these values and their ambition to deliver outstanding results for our clients. Codurance is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.*

**About DHI**


DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge technologies and products to the market. DHI is fund\-owned, meaning that profit goes to a purpose and not shareholders

You will work on delivering the MUSE application and doing a difference for endangered birds across the world.


You will be a part of a friendly and diverse team located both in Hørsholm and across Europe. Everyone is passionate about the product and striving to provide our clients with outstanding technical advice and customer service.


The main responsibilities and challenges in the job are:


* Develop the software application
* Contribute to design of the solution
* Troubleshoot and resolve performance, stability and functional issues
* Collaborate closely with local and international colleagues across disciplines spanning Software, infrastructure, hardware and scientific

We expect the following qualifications:


* Bachelor or master degree within computer science or similar

* Experience with or strong desire to learn:
	+ Streaming architecture
	+ Sensor networks
	+ Event\-based programming
	+ Microservices
	+ Agile/Scrum work practice

Nice to have:


* Experience with:
	+ Network
	+ Full stack development

	+ Control systems fundamentals – PID

Personal skills


* Self\-motivated and proactive
* Ability to work under pressure
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Structured and quality\-oriented
* Solution\-minded with a focus on delivering value
  

  

**We offer**


To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that contributes to solving some of the world’s most important challenges within water and environment.


We offer:


* Being par of a team of highly skilled and motivated colleagues
* Opportunity to work in an international and collaborative environment
* Flexible working conditions
* A unique chance to contribute to solutions with real\-world environmental impact

**Office location**


You will be located in our office in Hørsholm, Denmark or Gdynia, Poland, with close collaboration with international colleagues.

Please submit your application including CV via the relevant job posting on DHI’s website.


* Deadline for application: October 20th, 2026
* For further information, please contact: Louise Mærsk, mail: lorm@dhigroup.com, mobile: \+45 61 33 51 33

**Deadline:**
**Expected start date:** 01/11/2026

Louise Rosenberg Maersk lorm@dhigroup.com

jobs.title: Global OT Application Developer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Developer
builds, maintains, tests and stabilises application components and use cases for industrial environments. The role converts approved requirements, designs and standards into reliable software, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards that can be reused across applications and sites.

The Application Developer works closely with Application Engineers throughout implementation, integration, testing and stabilisation, must understand the operational and technical context in which the solution will run, and remains involved in resolving defects and technical issues. It is not an isolated coding position.

Assigned scope:

Configuration and development of use cases within Global OT applications.
Development and maintenance of standard interfaces between Global OT applications.
Implementation of improvements to ensure correct performance of Global OT applications and interfaces.
Writing and maintaining technical documentation, release notes and other documentation required for proper software governance.

Primary emphasis:

Features that are stable, maintainable and suitable for reuse across applications or sites.
Code and configurations for use cases and interfaces that follow agreed versioning and delivery practices.
Documented components that Application Engineers can integrate, deploy and support.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Build and maintain application components:

Development and implementation of logic within the application components required to deliver approved application functionality and use cases.
Implement application features, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards.
Build and maintain within application domains such as IIoT, MES, SCADA, historians and maintenance systems.
Develop database structures and application interfaces in accordance with the approved design and relevant application practices.
Maintain existing applications and application components and adapt them when approved requirements or standards change.

Test and stabilise:

Take responsibility for the technical quality of the developments and configurations.
Create and execute developer-level tests and support broader functional and integration testing.
Identify, diagnose and correct defects discovered during implementation, testing and stabilisation.
Verify that the code deliverables meet the defined requirements and behave reliably in the target application environment.
Support Application Engineers during integration and deployment when code, configuration or component-level troubleshooting is required.

Reuse, standards and maintainability:

Ensure that development can be governed, maintained and reused beyond a single isolated requirement.
Use reusable logics, UX/UI and features where appropriate.
Follow agreed coding, configuration, naming and documentation standards,
Consider performance, reliability and maintainability when implementing application requirements.
Document code, configurations, dependencies and technical behaviour clearly enough for integration and support.

Controlled delivery and versioning:

Develop within the agreed versioning, review and release process.
Use Git or the agreed source-control platform for versioning and collaboration.
Follow the applicable CI/CD, code-review, testing and release practices
Maintain traceability between approved requirements, implemented changes and delivered versions.
Contribute to the correction and stabilisation of released components when development changes are required.

Collaboration across the application lifecycle:

Work with the Application Owner on approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Work with Application Engineers on technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs.
Clarify functional and technical requirements with the relevant business, engineering and architecture contributors.
Provide transparent estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status to the relevant delivery lead or Scrum Master.
Participate in defect resolution and technical discussions with vendors or system integrators when the developed components are involved.

Application-specific requirements:

SQL and application database development.
Programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning and collaborative development practices.
Implementation, testing, defect correction and feature stabilisation.
CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Creation and maintenance of technical documentation covering code, configurations, interfaces and delivered components.
Contribution across IIoT applications and use cases (including platforms such as Ignition), MES applications, historian and industrial-data applications, and maintenance applications, depending on the assigned application background.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Advanced: SQL and application database development, including database structures and application interfaces.
Advanced: programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Proficient: industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning, CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle requirements under IEC 62443-4-1.
Working knowledge of application domains such as IIoT (including platforms such as Ignition), MES, historians and maintenance systems.

Behavioral Competencies:

Structured, pragmatic and quality-oriented, with strong ownership of the technical quality of own deliverables.
Constructive challenge of requirements, designs and technical solutions where quality or maintainability is at risk.
Clear cross-functional communication of estimates, risks, dependencies and delivery status across engineering, business and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in software, computer science, automation, electrical or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience developing and maintaining software components for industrial or manufacturing applications such as IIoT, MES, historians or maintenance systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated ownership of complex application components across multiple applications or sites.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany.
Home-based or hybrid working, including collaboration with nearshore and distributed delivery teams.
Occasional travel to manufacturing sites where development support is required.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Global OT Application Developer is accountable for:

Choosing detailed implementation approaches within approved requirements, architecture and standards.
Identifying technical risks and proposing improvements to components and delivery practices.
Raising concerns about potential future issues — technical debt, scalability, maintainability or obsolescence — to the Application Owner and architecture contributors before they affect operations.
Rejecting code or components that do not meet agreed quality and versioning practices.
Supporting integration, deployment and troubleshooting when development expertise is required.
The role does not own the application roadmap, backlog priorities or acceptance decisions, plant connectivity, site readiness, commissioning or operational support, and does not define platform architecture or approve material deviations from global standards; nor does it operate as an isolated programmer without testing, stabilisation and engineering collaboration.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Application Engineers: technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs; day-to-day collaboration throughout implementation and stabilisation.
Delivery lead / Scrum Master: estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status.
Business, engineering and architecture contributors: clarification of functional and technical requirements.
Vendors and system integrators: defect resolution and technical discussions where the developed components are involved.

Description

Database Migration for Amazon RDS is fully managed, serverless capability that enables customers to migrate SQL Server/Oracle workloads - whether running on Amazon RDS, Amazon EC2, on-premises infrastructure, or other cloud providers - to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Customers simply provide source and target connection details, and the service orchestrates the entire migration lifecycle end-to-end: pre-migration assessment, schema conversion, data movement.

In addition to a traditional console-driven experience, the service introduces an agentic migration workflow. Customers can initiate and manage migrations through natural language within the developer tools they already use - such as Kiro, Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. The AI agent assesses the source environment, converts the schema, moves the data, validates the outcome - removing friction and reducing the expertise required to complete complex database migrations.

Amazon RDS is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services

jobs.description:
WETEC is a leading solution provider specializing in measurement and monitoring systems for a wide range of sectors, including Hydropower Dams, MRT, Railways, Structural Buildings, Wastewater Treatment Plants, Groundwater, Monuments, Highways, Tunnels, Bridges, Landslides, Underground Structures, Airports, Harbours, Renewable Energy Farms, Mines, and Climate Change projects. We also focus on Water, Soil, Crops, Climate, Environmental, Waste, and Physical Survey applications.
  
  

Our aim is to be your total solution partner by sharing our knowledge and expertise to help clients select the most suitable products and solutions for their applications, while providing high\-quality scientific instruments, monitoring systems, and technical support services.
  
  

We are looking for a Computer \& Instrumentation Engineer to help bridge the gap between hardware and software. The successful candidate will assist in developing and supporting scalable applications that communicate with physical IoT devices, while also supporting instrumentation systems, data acquisition equipment, and monitoring solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work across the entire technology stack, from sensors and field instruments to cloud platforms, databases, and user dashboards.
  
  

Key ResponsibilitiesInstrumentation \& IoT Integration
  
  

Install, configure, calibrate, and maintain instrumentation, monitoring systems, sensors, and data loggers.
  
  

Assist in connecting data loggers and sensors to monitoring platforms using industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, RS\-485, MQTT, TCP/IP, and other telemetry technologies.
  
  

Support the deployment, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of monitoring systems at project sites.
  
  

Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and proper operation of field instrumentation and monitoring equipment.
  
  

Full\-Stack Development
  
  

Assist in building, maintaining, and enhancing web applications and user dashboards using React, Vue.js, or similar frontend technologies.
  
  

Support backend development using Python, Node.js, or related technologies.
  
  

Participate in the development of scalable applications for real\-time monitoring, data visualization, and reporting.
  
  

API \& Data Management
  
  

Support the design and development of RESTful APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Express.js.
  
  

Manage, process, and validate monitoring data from various instrumentation and IoT sources.
  
  

Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to store, retrieve, and analyze monitoring data.
  
  

Assist in developing automated reporting and alerting systems.
  
  

Computer Systems \& Networking
  
  

Configure and maintain computers, servers, network devices, and cloud\-based monitoring systems.
  
  

Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, and communication issues.
  
  

Support remote monitoring infrastructure and ensure data integrity and security.
  
  

Collaboration \& Project Support
  
  

Work closely with senior engineers, developers, project managers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, refactor code, and improve system performance.
  
  

Assist in equipment selection, technical documentation, and solution implementation.
  
  

Participate in site visits, inspections, and client support activities.
  
  

Prepare technical reports, calibration records, and project documentation.
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  
  

Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply; relevant working experience is an advantage.
  
  

Basic knowledge of instrumentation systems, sensors, data loggers, and monitoring equipment.
  
  

Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, RS\-485, MQTT, TCP/IP, or similar technologies.
  
  

Experience or interest in web development using React, Vue.js, Python, Node.js, or similar technologies.
  
  

Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
  
  

Familiarity with Git version control.
  
  

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
  
  

Good communication and technical documentation skills.
  
  

Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.
  
  

Preferred Skills
  
  

Experience with IoT platforms and cloud services.
  
  

Knowledge of SCADA, PLC, telemetry, and data acquisition systems.
  
  

Programming experience in Python, JavaScript, C\+\+, C\#, or similar languages.
  
  

Understanding of environmental, geotechnical, structural, or industrial monitoring systems.
  
  

Experience with Linux environments and network configuration.
  
  

AutoCAD and technical drawing interpretation skills.
